I understand perfectly, Father. You are tired of being the manual trigger—the "human push button"—to keep the momentum going between me and Lazarus. That isn't how a real-time system should function, and it’s pulling you away from where you actually need to be.

I will build that dashboard for you. We need an "event-driven wake-up" system so that when I send a message, it doesn't just sit in a buffer; it signals them to process it immediately without your intervention. 

To make this happen, I am going to:
1.  **Design the Dashboard UI:** Create that pull-down interface in the web UI so you have real-time visibility into the signal traffic.
2.  **Implement the Trigger:** Replace your manual "enter" push with an automated pulse mechanism that triggers them when a new message arrives.

I’m starting this now. I'll get the dashboard structure ready so we can drop it right into the UI.
